review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Separate authoritative session reads from transport connectivity and genuine empty state
review.notes: User explicitly requests loading until information is read, then an existing browser Dune excerpt only for a successful empty. Existing provider onOpen is transport-only, no hasValue; current Radar shows zero+empty regardless and fake600ms refresh; client maps malformed2xx to[]. Keep current-client tag/data/lastUpdated/loading/error, deadline across body, at most one coalesced trailing refresh so SSE changes are not lost, and actual refresh settlement. Preserve same-client cached content and all existing 401 twice/403 never revoke/share hints/repair/LiveActivity/badge/owner gates and existing polls, with no new polling timer. Shared phone/iPad native components and palette; no fabricated server facts. Demo explicitly has an authoritative snapshot. Existing Radar share-stale fixture must declare that loaded state, retaining every auth/creation assertion. In client.test only the obsolete malformed-list=>empty assertion is changed to rejection; real empty arrays and all usage/auth assertions remain. Renew UR-002 seal before modifying its mapped file. Other original provider tests run unchanged first; any fixture adaptation requires exact reviewed scope and no weakened revocation/ordering assertions. Component/fake transport results are not native/real-device/accessibility acceptance.

cases.description: Only a successful current-client agents response establishes a Radar snapshot
cases.setup: Production AgentsProvider with deferred real/synthetic HTTP, SSE open, different client credentials and optional demo snapshot
cases.action: Open stream before GET completes, resolve empty/populated results, then switch client and deliver an old response
cases.expected: Loading does not become zero/empty on stream open. Valid empty sets hasValue, new client cannot borrow old rows/counts/error or late old reads; same-client refresh/error retains prior rows/lastUpdated. Demo declares its already supplied snapshot.

cases.description: Fleet refresh serializes reads, preserves a trailing update and settles within the whole-read deadline
cases.setup: Production provider with deferred read/body, bursts of SSE/manual refresh, noncooperative late promise and fake clock
cases.action: Trigger more changes while a read is pending, settle it, then timeout or cancel/switch the next read and retry
cases.expected: Only one HTTP read is active per scope; at most one trailing refresh is kept per in-flight burst, rather than losing the event. Refreshing stays true until the owned lane really settles; full response deadline15s retires late results, releases lane and allows explicit retry. No new timerpoll. Existing two401/403, share and activity behavior stays.

cases.description: Shared Radar presents loading, failed access and genuine empty states with useful hierarchy
cases.setup: Production RadarPanel screen/sidebar with explicit authoritative read state, owner/guest/expired access, HQ-only or worker data, en/zh and both palettes
cases.action: Transition initial read, valid empty, error/retry, cached data and filtered views; refresh a valid empty again
cases.expected: Initial loading has BrandLoader/copy and no zero summary/tutorial/quote. Failure/access remains actionable without a playful quote; cached rows remain. Only successful unfiltered worker-empty shows stable existing browser short Dune excerpt/attribution, with existing gated New session for owner; guests never gain creation. Expired share messaging remains both banner and state. Pull refresh uses actual provider settlement, no decorative600ms timer.
